In the long years when the night grasped the land, the first Torchforger lit the flames that dispelled the darkness and swore vigilance against the black tide, so earning the royal edict that established the Lightkeepers.
Unlike the Marechaussee Hunters of the high seas, the Lightkeepers who patrolled the night did not possess any ancient techniques from a lost empire, or prestigious titles and ranks. All they could rely on was weak flesh clad in silver armor, the swords and lamps in their hands, and an ancient oath passed down through generations.
No matter how many souls perish beneath the dim light, the dark disaster cannot overturn mortal resolve — for the long night can only steal life, and not the dawn that will eventually rise.

name: Sundered Glory of the Far-North Scions
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
It is told that in the years before the country of gold and white stone sank, the moon-worshipping ancestors were guided by the star of dawn to build a tower reaching to the heavens.
Later on, the most transgressive of wild fantasies, one to unify life and the world into one, one that even the monarch who ruled all nations on earth failed to achieve, was toppled along with the city in the wrath of the high heavens.
The homeless survivors fled to the south by the waning light of the Frostmoon, chanting in tears of a glory that belonged to them millennia ago.

name: Unyielding Delusion of the Far-North Scions
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The grand city of gold and white stone was no more. Following the moonlight's pale guidance, its exiled inhabitants wandered to a desolate foreign land.
The glory and prowess of the past had dried up like morning dew, yet the earliest delusion still flowed beneath the skin of the proud, unlike the graves now lost to time.
Like farmers breeding their crops, the Archpriestesses who served the moonlight, for generation after generation, selected the purest bloodlines closest to their progenitors, no matter the cost...

name: Oblation of the Far-North Scions
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
A blade as pure as moonlight is the compassion of a benevolent hand.
In the name of mercy, all beings offer hope for tomorrow. Even those looking to be made whole can feel the moonlight's pristine blessing flowing beneath their skin. Even the smallest blessings, accumulated, can guide the pious scions immersed in them closer to the coming Elysium.
All sins and wicked thoughts are cleansed by the pristine moonlight, all tears and suffering are necessary sacrifices — at least that is what the people who worship the moon once firmly believed.

name: Aureate Radiance of the Far-North Scions
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
With the unblessed birth of the prophesied son, a millennia-long plan ushered in a bleak twilight.
A scheme born of cunning was shattered by foolish betrayal. The youth who was supposed to be king took the maid who was supposed to serve him and stole the secret treasure that was supposed to be his, only to reject the crowns that fate had ordained for him.
In time, the king who was destined to rule Elysium went down in history as an unpardonable thief, and by the time the true new moon shone upon the land, the far north's final wish of golden grandeur had already been buried by a priestess, who had never believed in any god, in the empty grave of her king.

name: Rise of the Pale Star Army
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
In the east of the tundra, that arrogant monster born within the wing-like mountain is nothing more than a lowly peddler of malt and minerals.
The Vila under his command are but weaklings with insect wings, while the Domovoy cannot even lift weapons with their stunted arms.
Who would heed the clamor of such rabble? What strength could they possibly have to stand against the onslaught of the kings of Volkodlak?

name: Muster of the Pale Star Army
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"They seized the canyon by sheer luck. That laughably arrogant fool is no more than a spent bolt, a fading gale."
"Even with all their strength, they can barely hold back a fraction of our forces. Soon enough, their defeat will be plain to see."
"Soldiers, march onward! For our king has already foretold, for this entire campaign shall end in effortless victory!"

name: Clarion of the Pale Star Army
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"Our enemy Monomakh has built his palace beyond the valley, a sign that he is fully confident in his ability to contend with us."
"As matters stand, he deserves our utmost caution. Any talk of a swift victory should now be set aside."
"But it matters not. With wisdom to guide us all, the King shall stand with the clans to overcome every hardship and usher in a glorious new era!"

name: Triumph of the Pale Star Army
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"All hail the Tsar, Protector of all fae, Heir to the Pale Star, sovereign born of sacred blood!"
"Praise be, for the entire tundra now stands as one beneath the brilliance of the Polestar!"
"Praise be, for His Majesty has slain the false king and embraced all fae. Such is his benevolence, such is his mercy!"

name: Measured Pour of the Cellared Spiritual Nectar
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The radiance that once gleamed like the aurora in the northernmost sky was extinguished when it met the gaze from high above.
The calamity of bitter cold and black crystal nearly destroyed the foundations upon which all life endured.
Only the fae, unafraid of the cold, were able to emerge from the ice and snow to rule over the deserted realm.

name: Intoxication of the Cellared Spiritual Nectar
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
What others enjoy as a festive indulgence after a bountiful grain harvest is a necessity of survival for the clans who walk through the bitter cold.
It is said that the Domovoy, whose mastery of brewing was without equal, once relied on this art to enrich the treasury of the king they served.
And so, passed from clan to clan through trade, the fae's brew flowed across the frozen lands like honey laced with poison.

name: Exhilaration of the Cellared Spiritual Nectar
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
Legend has it that long ago, countless casks of fine wine were poured into a frozen lake.
Some say the wine was intended as wartime provisions, which had to be destroyed after some mishap. Others say a certain Grand Duke of the Domovoy had lost a bet to the ruler of the Water Imps.
Only when unquenchable azure hellflame spread across the lake, and the foes below writhed in choking waves, did they come to understand:
In the hands of the people well versed in the turning of the world, water itself could burn, and even the sweetest nectar could prove deadlier than poison.

name: Revelry of the Cellared Spiritual Nectar
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The Grand Duke of the Domovoy commanded the crystal mines and the development of the frozen lands. To him, carving an oasis out of the polar wastes was a mere trifle, and importing rye of better quality was no difficult task either.
Even among the many fae nobles who had endured in Snezhnaya to this day, none could rival the splendor of his status.
Yet the flame of ambition burned ever brighter, licking its way down his throat, while the ancient fae's greed swelled with the years and knew no end.

name: The Frost Emperor's Revival
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The hero who emerged from the snowfields had yet to become the ruler of that frozen realm, but even then, he had already shown a habit of confiding far too much to those around him.
So he was all the more surprised when he received a gift from the fae of snow, who at the time had not yet taken their human form.
As far as he knew, he never told them that he was born from an egg as pale as ice deep within the wing-like mountains, nor did he ever mention the date of his birth.

name: The Frost Emperor's Ceremony
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The fae of the court didn't understand why a gift meant for the Tsar must be made in such shape. They knew only to lavish their craft upon ornaments bright as jewels.
Only the Tsar seated upon the throne and the fae of snow understood the meaning behind it.
For what mattered was never the ceremony, but the ancient truth it preserved.

name: The Frost Emperor's Lament
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
On the night the truth stirred like bitter waves, she prepared this gift for her friend upon the throne—though she herself was no longer the person she used to be.
They both seemed to understand that they might never speak to each other like this again.
For after that night, the path they once walked together diverged—sundered by the weakness of one, and the fury of the other.

name: The Frost Emperor's Farewell
description:
Weapon Ascension Material.
An object that appeared upon the table on the eve of war, though none knew when or how it'd come to be there.
He recognized it for the handiwork of the friend he hadn't seen for many long years.
Only then did he realize, that this was the beginning of every calamity, the bitter fruit of every desire, and the omen of every destruction.
